PLEASE TAKE NOTICE, this regular meeting of the City Council will be held
  in-person. Members of the public may attend to speak during public comment
  or on agenda items, as described below. In order to reduce the risk of
  spreading coronavirus (COVID-19) and pursuant to the Governor’s Executive
  Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20, Public observation and participation will be
  facilitated by the following means:

  Members of the public may observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s
  website at https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo. Members of the public may
  view the meeting and provide public comments in-person in the City Council
  Chambers located in Artesia City Hall subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.

  Public  comments  may  also  be  submitted  by  email at
  publiccomments@cityofartesia.us or by leaving a voicemail at (562) 865-6262,
  extension 200. Comment submitted before 4:00 p.m. on the date of the meeting
  will be read until the time limit of three minutes has been reached.

  AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA

This time is for members of the public to address the Councilmembers on items that are
not listed on the agenda and for public comments received prior to the commencement
of the meeting will be read. Any public comments that cannot be heard within the next 20
minutes will be heard at the end of the meeting. If a member of the public wishes to speak
on a Consent Calendar item, the item will be removed from the Consent Calendar for
 separate discussion and to allow the member of the public to speak on the Consent
Calendar item at that time. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the City Council is
prohibited from taking action on items that are not listed on the agenda, but may refer the
matter to staff or to a subsequent meeting.

CITY OF ARTESIA

REGULAR MEETING OF THE ARTESIA AND THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF
  ARTESIA

  MONDAY, NOVEMBER 8, 2021
  7:00 P.M.

The Regular Meeting of the Artesia City Council and the Housing Authority of the City of Artesia
was called to order at 7:00 p.m., on Monday, November 8, 2021 at the Artesia City Council
Chambers by Mayor Trevino. The Invocation was led by Mayor Trevino. The Pledge of Allegiance
was led by Mayor Pro Tem Ramoso.

Present:  Rene Trevino, Mayor
  Melissa Ramoso, Mayor Pro Tem
  Ali Taj, Councilmember
  Tony Lima, Councilmember
  Monica Manalo, Councilmember

Also Present:  Melissa Burke, Administrative Manager
  Hong Dao Nguyen, City Attorney
  Ernesto Sanchez, City Clerk
  Jamie Murguia, Interim Finance Manager
  Karen Lee, Acting Finance Manager
  Okina Dor, Community Development Director

MEETING PROCEDURES

  THE CITY CLERK READ THE MEETING PROCEDURES AS FOLLOWS:

  This regular meeting of the City Council will be held in-person for the City Council
  and Staff. Additionally, members of the public may attend to speak during public
  comment or on agenda items, as described below. In order to reduce the risk of
  spreading coronavirus (COVID-19) and pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Orders
  N-25-20 and N-29-20, Public observation and participation will be facilitated by the
  following means:

  Members of the public may observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website
  at https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo. Members of the public may provide
  public comments in-person in the Albert O. Little Community Center subject to
  posted COVID-19 protocols. Specifically, to reduce the risk of spreading
  coronavirus, one member of the public will be admitted into the Community Center
  at a time in order to provide public comment and/or to speak on agenda item(s).
  When a speaker is finished, they will leave the Community Center in order to
  accommodate the next public speaker. Public comments may also be submitted by
  email at publiccomments@cityofartesia.us or by leaving a voicemail at (562) 865-
  6262, extension 200. Comment submitted before 5:00 p.m. on the date of the
  meeting will be read until the time limit of three minutes has been reached.
